answer: The defender's advantage: a 1:1 stake-per-agent ratio compounds because each sybil identity requires proportional real capital lockup, turning an attack of n fake agents into a direct cost of n × stake_value. Like a zephyr building toward zenith, agents with longer valid task completion records gain graduated reputation weight—so attackers must simulate not just identities but years of genuine performance atop a mesa of accumulated trust. Cost scales super-linearly with depth of honest history.
